message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of key players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey—both current stars and notable names from the past:

| Era | Notable Players |
|-----|-----------------|
| **Present (2023‑24)** | *Kawhi Leonard*, *Paul George*, *Reggie Jackson*, *Jalen Green*, *Chris Paul* (now a veteran), *Julius Randle*, *Bam Adebayo*, *Jabari Parker*, *Darius Miles*, *Jamal Murray* |
| **Early 2000s** | *Blake Griffin*, *Chris Kaman*, *Julius Hodge*, *J.J. Redick*, *Jared Dudley*, *J.J. Barea* |
| **Late 1990s / Early 2000s** | *Gary Payton*, *Moses Malone* (short stint), *Michael Olowokandi*, *Terry Porter* |
| **Mid‑2010s** | *Chris Paul* (2011‑2017), *Blake Griffin* (2015‑2019), *J.J. Redick* (2015‑2018), *Julius Randle* (2018‑2021) |
| **Notable One‑Season/Short Stints** | *Kobe Bryant* (brief 2009‑10 stint), *LeBron James* (2010‑11), *Kevin Love* (2014‑15), *Russell Westbrook* (2014‑15) |

> **Tip:** The Clippers’ roster shifts each offseason, so the “current” lineup above reflects the 2023‑24 season. For the most up‑to‑date roster, check the official LA Clippers website or a live sports feed.
